correctness.rationale: An all-prime symbolic proof: quadratic-character correlation gives \(|\det K_p|=p^{(p+1)/2}\); a group-algebra \(t\)-adic leading coefficient gives rank \((p+1)/2\) modulo \(p\) and exact prime-level Smith factors. Hensel lifting gives an exact prime-square root-count identity; unimodular coset-basis operations reduce its \(p\)-local Smith form to \(I_p\oplus pI_{p(p-2)}\oplus p^2K_p\). The integral determinant \(p^{p^2}|\det K_p|\) excludes all other primes. The supplied exact checker passed 46,351 assertions with direct Smith tests at \(p=3,5\), not used as a replacement for proof.

value.rationale: The square-root representation operator \(K_{p^2}\) is canonical for the congruence \(x^2\equiv b-a\pmod {p^2}\), and exponent two is the first odd-prime depth where singular nonunit fibers occur. The formula gives the entire naturally motivated finite cokernel (not merely determinant), its uniform maximum exponent \(p^4\), and the rank drop modulo \(p\). The explicit integral decomposition explains the arithmetic discontinuity between the field and its first ring lift. It is an infinite-prime structural classification, not an arbitrary small-prime example.
